priorities.finding: The Phase-1 record schema enforces claim_promotion=false, but a dedicated ledger-bound handoff primitive was absent at A84 time.
priorities.reproduction: Search main@bb1f3fd for A83 handoff schema/validator; A84 found zero A83 artifacts.
priorities.remediation: Add strict A83 handoff schema, deterministic validator/sentinel, and fail-closed decision function.

priorities.finding: The Phase-1 schema correctly separates OBS/RA/SR; external prototypes using shortened OBS1/RA1/SR1 labels are incompatible with the canonical enums.
priorities.reproduction: Compare canonical scientific-communication-v1 enums with the Grok browser-local A82 prototype.
priorities.remediation: Require exact canonical enums in A83 envelopes and reject incompatible classes.

priorities.finding: The Phase-1 ledger rejects duplicate record IDs, hash-chain breaks, tampered object bytes, and orphan content-addressed records. A83 handoffs additionally need parent membership validation.
priorities.reproduction: Run existing ledger tests plus A83 parent-not-in-ledger test.
priorities.remediation: Validate parent_record_sha256 against an existing communication-ledger record when repository root is supplied.

priorities.finding: Phase-1 communication records have no handoff-specific expiry primitive.
priorities.reproduction: Inspect scientific-communication-v1 schema; no handoff sunset field exists.
priorities.remediation: Require sunset_months >= 12 in A83 handoff envelopes; future revisions should define renewal semantics before operational authorization.

priorities.finding: Deterministic string sentinels can detect declared forbidden phrases but cannot establish semantic absence of overclaim.
priorities.reproduction: Paraphrase a prohibited proposition without sentinel phrases.
priorities.remediation: Treat sentinels as structural guardrails only; retain human/independent review for substantive semantic adjudication.

open_questions: How should sunset renewal be represented without rewriting history?
Should a future handoff record be a dedicated record_type in scientific-communication-v2 or remain an envelope linked to a generic event?
Which external identity assurance mechanisms can be added without making them mandatory for baseline interoperability?
How should independent revalidation be represented after the historical A84 C1.2_CLOSED result?
